scope: One functional arithmetic visual slice; independent from production game and saves

visualFindings.composition: Original shallow parchment, decorative dark/gold plaques, wooden posts, arena, heroine, fox and turtle retained. Compared side by side with the supplied reference.
visualFindings.controls: One canonical wood frame. Numerals optically centered; selected outlines remain inside bevel. Frame, mark and numeral share one moving surface, stable root hit area.
visualFindings.layout: No text/button overlap observed in the reviewed desktop and tablet states. Runtime power and total fit their original plaques.
visualFindings.preReader: Only Celkem appears as optional player-facing text. Muted and word-hidden tablet captures preserve the full number-selection, sword-strength, check/cross, object correction and continuation flow.
visualFindings.feedback: Wrong answer supplies zero strength and demonstrates 2 apples plus 3 apples; correct answer enters the empty slot. Frame outline plus check/cross avoids relying on color alone.
visualFindings.aspect: All complete bitmap art uniformly scaled. Intentional symmetric crop of outer scenery only. Original plaque and button proportions retained.
visualFindings.motion: Surface lift/press, answer flight, total count and short power particle. No creature warping or fabricated animation.
visualFindings.renderers: WebGL and Canvas inspected; text resolution/source resolution both 2.

database: No migration required: no DB middleware or client initialization in this preview. Browser observed zero API calls and zero localStorage writes.
limitations: Only arithmetic is exposed; additional board variants wait for visual approval.
Decorative plaques and actors remain in the static reference backdrop for this isolated slice. Production scene-editor repositioning/replacement needs separate artwork layers.
Touch tests use browser emulation at tablet dimensions; no physical Samsung hardware was connected.
Bundled Gelasio replaces OS-specific Georgia so tablet rendering is deterministic. It is close to the reference, not an identical font.
No claim of child playtest or author visual approval.
tooling: Playwright MCP was attempted but reported the shared browser in use. A separate Playwright browser performed the isolated visual and interaction checks without closing that browser.
